cohort: Nine deliberately selected products from a user-supplied recurring online-grocer purchase list

method.observation: Manual read-only inspection of a UK online grocer's public product pages in Safari
method.selection: Purposeful contract-edge sample: prepared produce, drained fish, edible bones, canned pulses, processed bread, soda water, raw meat, frozen fish and dairy
method.privacy: The supplied purchase dates, quantities, frequencies and prices were used only to select cases and are not retained in this artefact
method.mutations: None; no basket, order, review or account action

interpretation: The live pages are useful dated corroborating evidence for exact product and decisive-attribute review, including drained basis, edible bones, preparation state and bounded label values. They are mutable retailer pages, not immutable source releases: no sampled page provides a formulation-effective date, and eight of nine expose no public UPC or GTIN. The observation therefore does not promote the grocer's pages into the canonical Phase 1 source stack and does not independently establish Open Food Facts exact-variant coverage.
